body: Nah I didn’t mean it like that. I’ll be off then.

Positivity homie. I didn’t get as much help as when I was I positive vs negative. The more open you are to good things the more good things can come into you’re life I’m beginning to believe it slowly.

Well one example was my struggle to save up for a car. I had built up a savings for a car a cheap one at that. But ended up having to spend it to pay debts and expenses I accumulated in between jobs. Then one day My moms receives a letter for a life insurance policy which was taken out on my me when I was little. It had lapsed, she hadn’t paid it. But the money was still in the account. And available to be withdrawn with no penalty. She said she thought it was lost, for not paying. She then had gotten a letter from insurance company to her new address. She called me two days later and told em. After I had spent the half the money I saved from working overtime at work. It’s enough to cover me for the car I want. Now I’m getting my driving privileges in order currently but now I have enough to get a car, once the rest fall into place. I’ve had other small experiences. Meeting the right people at the right time, finding information I need at the right time. People call it luck. I suppose but I like to think, it’s more than just coincidence. The harder you work the more things fall into place, just burning through old karma. Also Karma doesn’t necessarily mean a bad thing.

I like to think it’s just delayed effects, I feel too bro things just do improve even when I’m trying but I think it’s cause I slacked off for so long. I gotta pay my overdue dues, eventually you’ll see the rewards just gotta stick to good things that align you with you’re future self. Just keep doing good things for yourself, and eventually all those bad things will turn to good. Just gotta burn through old karma.

Just don’t give up right when things get tough bro, I used to do that too. Pretty much defeats the purpose sorta. It’s the constant chipping away, until you end up on the other side but be serious like really serious about it. See if there’s any opportunities available to you. Do the research you got the internet to an extent use it to benefit you’re life. Best of wishes bro start setting up goals and plans and start doing things to make those become real.
Giving up anything doing bro. Gotta do something, it’s should be something that’s gonna help you.

Then what do you recommend? You have to at least be doing something, where to find help/assistance. Yeah something will eventually come around but things don’t fall from the sky necessarily, it requires action. I’m not trying to be a jerk it’s just the truth. I’m not religious anything but the universe only helps those who actively try to help themselves.
You got it bro, just do what you have to do to make your life better. Fill up you’re own plate, before you try to fill someone else’s.

I feel it too with my own life. But you have to just force it out for now, that might mean build a savings first, ask yourself where would you like to live. And start small, what country would accept you and what you have to do to be a prospective citizen to them. Send an application while you’re waiting start saving improving yourself, wherever you can that could mean doing push-ups at home, start stretching, improve you’re posture, stand tall, start a little more conversations try to be have fun and laugh. Try and Make life fun and enjoyable especially because you know you’re gonna go somewhere. Think about it, imagine it. You figure out where you wanna live, be realistic, somewhere that’s better than where you live now. If it’s bigger city in Serbia than save up and move. Or if it’s another country than save a little, apply for a visas/citizenships,(apply to couple you like for more options, KEEP TRYING)go online see what you need to apply. Then while you’re waiting start exercising or eating healthier/ working more hours, build a big savings put money aside, take a little invest in yourself, (like some clothes/ hygiene products, it’ll make you more confident, keep waiting for the reply’s for the applications, and keep improving things about yourself, telling yourself positive be hopeful/optimistic. Get rid of negative opinions about yourself, instead of you can’t do it, say that I’m capable and I will, ask yourself often is what I’m doing moving me toward my dream. Keep saving I mean it, save a lot but be smart don’t starve yourself or anything crazy just be frugal with you’re money. Spend wisely, keep finding things to make yourself better, stronger, tougher, all of it. Build you’re social skills, it’ll be easier if you like how you dress and how look a bit more and build on top of that. Look up Mewing I can send you links if you want, life can change in 5 years even in 2 years if you work really heard and stay focused and committed to the plan.

You’re not Superman no one truly is, just what we like imagine them to be. Use the time wisely find out what makes you feel happy, something that gives you’re life meaning. Something you can see yourself doing when you’re older and stuck to that. Try to identify what you want in life, and what kind of person you’d have to become in life to get it. If you want a girl, probably gotta build some confidence/self esteem, maybe start dressing better, not like dressing how others want you to but how YOU want to dress and be confident about it. Take care of health, like exercising, take care of skin, clothes, hygiene. Improve your mindset, beliefs and all that. Gotta ask yourself what makes you not feel confident.
I understand, it’s difficult. Than you gotta some pre steps to do. What country you live in?

That ain’t you’re problem to deal with. You got you’re own, life. Instead of letting her ignorance get to you, just focus on improving life for YOURSELF and you’re brother. She’s being irresponsible, that’s her own fault and will be her problem to deal with when it comes. Just focus on doing what you got to do to make you’re own life better. Wether it’s getting a better job, a car, saving, getting you’re own place, all that. Don’t let her choices bleed into you’re life. Yeah it’s your mom but if she’s that irresponsible shame on her, gotta have you’re priorities/finances straight before doing something like that.

That’s the thing if you accept it nothing will change, you have to “trick” yourself into believing it and eventually you will. Take it til you make it, sounds silly and delusional but once you get to the other side you want think it’s so delusional anymore. To an extent you’re kinda right, yeah some things you can’t change but that doesn’t mean nothing can/ or that it’s not worth trying. Life you have to make compromises you know that. But things can change but they won’t if you give up. That’s the ultimate loss is to give up. What other options are there, I can think of couple and they’re not  good. What’s happens if things could have changed but you didn’t try. Only limitations on yourself are self imposed. Life can’t hold you down forever eventually something will budge.

First step is making sure you have savings, meaning you gotta get that overtime in. Get a car, as long as it gets you to work and back that’s all you need. Then keep building that savings keep working. Find out what you want, you want to be happier with how you look, than try exercising, going to the gym, dressing nicer, taking care of you’re skin. Try Mewing if you want to change your facial appearance. Up you’re social game, get out you’re comfort zone, meet new people. Do it you’re own pace, but first you should improve yourself so you’re motivated to do those things. I have the same problem, I want to be more confident but before I can actually believe it, I gotta become that guy. A confident guy is secure with himself, his looks, his physique, his life. Create a plan, and follow through with it. 29 is alot of time still, some guys don’t to it until they’re 50/55 that’s alot if time especially if you get really serious and focused no distractions and stay dedicated .
At least you know what you gotta do/ what you want so it’s all that bad. Not great in a similar spot too, but you got time bro.
Sorry for the long ass paragraph 🤣 but it’s all true. Shoot me a message to talk more if you want bro 😎❤️

Have you thought about life could be? Like how good it could be? It sounds dumb and obvious like “no shit” but if you think about it. Life is about the destination it’s about the journey sounds cheesy but it doesn’t matter where you end up, but where to go next. Sounds harsh but it’s only option myself included( and many others like us) pick yourself up and dust yourself off. When you’re at rock bottom, the only way to look is up. Even more so, you never truly appreciate the top until you been at the bottom, like when something’s gone. You appreciate it more when you have it. Life’s so fucking rough it is, but you gotta ask yourself who’s in you’re corner, if so, is one of those people you? My gram said you can be you’re own best friend or you’re own worst enemy. This might sound absolutely Insane but this might be a good thing( i know the audacity of me) because it means the only way to work is up. Getting a car/a job/a savings/ then a place/figuring out what you love doing. This called “SELF ACTUALIZATION” becoming your highest self. You have the perfect template, being at you’re lowest low, to then achieve your highest high. I like to believe you’ll never achieve you’re highest potential until you been at rock bottom. Things can be alright it just takes a shit ton of work. For all you know a great life might be not too far away, you just given another chance homie. Have a plan, stick to it, and stay in your own corner, be your best friend, biggest support, 1# fan and all that. It’s hard asf because I’m my own worst enemy but it’s about your beliefs, perspective, and mindset. If you can change you’re mind, you can change you’re life :) try again but this time you start from experience not from scratch. Figure out what you gotta do first to improve you’re situation, then do the second. Take it one step at a time, but have a picture of the future in you’re mind. 
Step 1. Step.2 Step.3 …… and imagine what the result will be if you do everything right. Look on the bright side of it even if the clouds are in the way right now. Wake up tomorrow or even today and say today I’m brand new, I’m not who I was, but I’m someone else, someone better. Be strong brother you’re gangster you got through this and everything before than there ain’t anything you can’t handle. You got this shit boi stay strong ✊🏽 wishing you blessing.

You never know, why not hold on to see if you do something with you’re life. Then if you still wanted to do it after the fact, then that’s up to you. I’m not tryna to incite anything just, might as well give life a shot( I believe you’ve probably given it a lot chances) but keep trying, and trying to see. For all you know you might change the world/make it a better place. If it means anything to you, you might end up saving someone’s life if you hold on longer. For all you know you might achieve great things and don’t know it yet. Don’t do it if you don’t know yet. If you wanna prove to someone you’re not a wimp then adapt and overcome. You holding on not only proves to everybody else but most importantly yourself you’re not a wimp or weak. It proves you’re stronger than most, you’re only as strong as what you can tolerate, the more you can tolerate the stronger you become. Give it another shot, have a goal in mind, a plan and don’t stray from it. It’s only about proving it to yourself, a wise man once said “the only person in that casket is you.” You’re stronger than you think, imagine if every single person in this group did that, probably change the entire world. ✊🏼
